records.text: Frank Turek said he found Charlie Kirk's missing necklace across his bag, refused a police officer's request to take it because Erika Kirk wanted it, put it in his pocket and removed valuables from the bag while traveling to Salt Lake City.
records.speaker: Frank Turek

appearances.snippet: This necklace, which we were looking for, was across the top of it. He was wearing a necklace and it came off, and Erika (Erika Kirk) had asked, where's his necklace? Because it wasn't on his body. And so as I'm pulling the bag out, there's this necklace. ... And the cop there goes, I'll take that. I go, no, you won't. You're not taking this. I'm giving this to Erika (Erika Kirk). She wants it, you know. ... So I just put it in my pocket. And as we drove to Salt Lake City, I took everything of value out of that bag. I'm wearing scrubs now.
